name: Thunder Bluff
summary: On Mulgore’s high mesas, Thunder Bluff shelters the tauren as their capital. Cairne Bloodhoof founded the city after the Third War, bringing a people long scattered across Kalimdor together in a place of refuge and tradition.

sections.title: A Refuge Upon the Mesas
sections.body: Thunder Bluff rises above Mulgore, where rope bridges link its stone mesas and wooden elevators carry travelers up from the plains. For generations, the tauren wandered across central Kalimdor, pursued by centaur raiding parties. During the Third War, Cairne Bloodhoof joined with Warchief Thrall and the New Horde. Together, they drove back the centaurs and claimed Mulgore’s fertile grasslands. Cairne gathered the scattered tribes and founded the city atop the mesas, where the heights offered shelter and a place for the tauren to trade and gather in worship.

sections.title: Unity and Gathering Mists
sections.body: Cairne Bloodhoof’s followers share Thunder Bluff with tauren who hold to other ways. Magatha Grimtotem and her kin dwell on the Elder Rise, while spirit walkers and shaman seek the ancestors’ will at the Pools of Vision beneath the city. Tribal rivalries persist, yet Thunder Bluff remains a spiritual pillar of Kalimdor’s Horde. Hunters return from the Barrens, artisans travel through, and druids come to commune with the Earth Mother.

faq.q: How do travelers get up to Thunder Bluff?
aliases: how to get up to tb
faq.answer: Travelers ascend to Thunder Bluff by wooden rope and pulley elevators on the southwestern and northeastern bluffs, or fly to the wind rider roost atop the central mesa.

faq.q: Why did the tauren build their city on cliffs?
faq.answer: After centuries of centaur raids across the open plains, Cairne Bloodhoof chose the stone mesas for a refuge above Mulgore’s sacred grazing grounds.
High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof leads Thunder Bluff. He united the scattered tribes and secured peace in Mulgore, with counsel from tribal leaders and elders across the rises.

faq.q: Are all tauren tribes loyal to Cairne?
faq.answer: Most tauren revere Cairne’s wisdom, but some tribes, especially the Grimtotem led by Magatha, doubt the Horde alliance and seek their own course for the tauren people.

angles.text: For the tauren, Thunder Bluff is their first lasting home after generations of wandering, and holds their sacred totems, spirit lodges, and greatest chieftains.
As a member of the Horde, you have Thunder Bluff as a stronghold in southern Kalimdor, with wisdom and resources alongside Orgrimmar.
